notes.text: - **NPDM**: approved by the Union Cabinet **22 October 2009** (exam answer for "approved / enforced"); prepared by NDMA under the DM Act; vision **"safe and disaster-resilient India"**; mainstreaming DRR into development, partnership with the **media**, identification and monitoring of risks. **NOT an objective**: "preparedness only after a disaster occurs". Primary responsibility: **State Government**.

exam: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2020 (15-03-2020)
q: Who was the first Chairman of the High Powered Committee, established to formulate a systematic, comprehensive and holistic approach to all disasters?
explanation: The High Powered Committee set up in August 1999 was chaired by J.C. Pant.

notes.text: - Constituted **August 1999**; first chairman **J.C. Pant**; reported **2001**; theme **"Building a Culture of Prevention"**; first natural disasters only, later man-made too.

exam: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer 2017
q: What is the current approach of UN framework in post-disaster recovery and reconstruction?
explanation: The UN (Sendai Framework) approach to post-disaster recovery and reconstruction is 'Build Back Better'.

notes.text: - **Build Back Better** = the current UN approach to post-disaster recovery and reconstruction.

exam: APPSC AEE Screening Test 2016
q: As per the High Powered Disaster Management Committee Report, 2001, in terms of vulnerability, an L2 type indicates manageability with resources at
explanation: In the HPC/NDMP levels L1 is manageable at district level, L2 at State level and L3 needs national help; L0 is normal time.

notes.text: - Levels: **L0 = normal times (normalcy)**, **L1 = district level**, **L2 = State level**, **L3 = national level** (used in NDMP 2016).

exam: APPSC
q: The High Powered Committee on Disaster Management which recommended that a separate Department of Disaster Management be set up in the Government of India was set up in ____.
explanation: The High Powered Committee on Disaster Management was set up in August 1999 and recommended a separate Department of Disaster Management.

notes.text: - Constituted **August 1999**; first chairman **J.C. Pant**; reported **2001**; theme **"Building a Culture of Prevention"**; first natural disasters only, later man-made too.
- Identified **31 types of disasters** in **five broad categories**; recommended a **separate Department of DM** in GoI.

q: Which among the following decades was declared as International decade for Natural Disaster Reduction (IDNDR)?
explanation: The UN declared the 1990s (1990-1999) the International Decade for Natural Disaster Reduction; '1990-2000' is the option meant.
